name: print-social-berry-sticker-drop-basket-post
title: Fruit stickers dropping into a wicker basket on cobalt
whatItIs: A 4:5 post on flat cobalt with cream-outlined bubble headline 'We pick only fresh berries for you'. Eight cut-out fruits with thin cream borders fall towards a real wicker basket cropped at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Fresh, juicy and playful; bright fruit against strong blue looks like candy.
techniques: Use complementary contrast (orange and red fruit on blue) for maximum pop.
Outline stickers and headline with the same cream stroke to unify them.
Imply motion by scattering objects at different angles above their destination.
Crop a real object (basket) at the edge as a stage.
bestFor: Any product with many small items

vocabulary.definition: A thin border around a cutout.
Objects scattered above a container to imply motion.
Text with a thick stroke around the letters.
